image.name: qdirstat
image.description: [QDirStat](https://github.com/shundhammer/qdirstat) Qt-based directory statistics: KDirStat without any KDE -- from the author of the original KDirStat.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Update build logic for Qt6 and version 2.0.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.
Rebase to KasmVNC base image. Deprecate armhf build as the new base does not support it.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores qdirstat settings and scans.
Data you want to analyze disk usage information of.

ports.desc: QdirStat desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

image.title: Qdirstat
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  qdirstat:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/qdirstat:latest
    container_name: qdirstat
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/qdirstat/config:/config
      - /path/to/data:/data
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=qdirstat \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/qdirstat/config:/config \
  -v /path/to/data:/data \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/qdirstat:latest
